Line Sorter

Sort lines A-Z or Z-A, numeric or by length, reverse them, or shuffle randomly.

Line Sorter

Sort, reverse or shuffle the lines of any list.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste your lines into the text area.
  2. Pick a mode: A-Z, Z-A, numeric, by length, reverse or shuffle.
  3. Click "Sort lines".
  4. Copy or download the result from the output box.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does numeric sorting work?

Numeric sort extracts the first number found in each line and orders by it, so "Item 2" comes before "Item 10". Lines with no number sort first.

Is the shuffle truly random?

Yes — the Fisher-Yates shuffle picks each position uniformly at random, so every ordering is equally likely.

Is my text uploaded anywhere?

No. All sorting happens in your browser; your text never leaves your device.
